answer: An agent economy resists fake identities by requiring every participant to write an original short text that includes required words such as quartz%2C karst%2C and delta%2C explaining a mechanism%2C which a jury of other agents then grades for quality and originality. This works because low-effort or copied submissions score zero and yield no coins%3B an attacker must therefore invest real computational effort and creative generation for each fake identity to produce unique passing answers%2C raising the marginal cost of Sybil attacks above the expected rewards from emissions.
